sources.games: 505 league games since 7.40 (7.41 alone had under 300) (data/heroes/item_stats), win 45.9%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py phantom_assassin.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Mjollnir, Eye of Skadi, Aghanim's Scepter.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-19: Aghanim's Scepter (Fan of Knives) against break heroes; Nullifier at times more universal than MKB; Stifling Dagger first unless the lane is hard.

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion; Nullifier is the wider answer when they save with Ghost Scepter, Glimmer Cape or Force Staff
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення; Nullifier універсальніший, коли вас рятують Ghost Scepter, Glimmer Cape чи Force Staff

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast. High-rank Phantom Assassins against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 22% of 27 games against them (7% otherwise), won 33% against 43%; Nullifier 18% of 27 games against them (6% otherwise), won 80% against 32% (27 games). Valve 7.41f Nullifier: Nullify dispels the target (basic dispel: Ghost Scepter, Glimmer Cape, a Force Staff push) and keeps dispelling and slowing for 4 s. The player review: Nullifier is sometimes the more universal item.

rules.name: Aghanim's Scepter

reason.en: {enemy} relies on {spell}: {item} gives you Fan of Knives, which breaks it in an area
reason.uk: {enemy} тримається на здатності {spell}: {item} дає Fan of Knives, яка вимикає її по площі

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Fan of Knives is granted by Aghanim's Scepter; it deals 30% of each victim's max health in 550 radius and applies Break for 4 s. High-rank Phantom Assassins against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: 21% of 28 games against them (7% otherwise), won 33% against 41% (28 games).

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 87% (3), power_treads 99% (6), pers 36% (10), bfury 99% (14), yasha 38% (19), desolator 67% (20), manta 23% (22), black_king_bar 68% (24), basher 65% (27), sange 40% (28), satanic 36% (31), aghanims_shard 24% (32), abyssal_blade 26% (32).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 85.0%+: 25:00 18000 (20 games, 85.0%), 30:00 20500 (49 games, 87.8%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

suppress.illusions: Battle Fury (99% of his won games, ~14 min) already cleaves the illusions around his target; high-rank Phantom Assassin players do not add Maelstrom against illusion heroes.

skills.basis: 505 games: maxed Stifling Dagger > Phantom Strike > Immaterial 208 (win 51.9%), Phantom Strike > Stifling Dagger > Immaterial 238 (win 45.8%). The player review: Stifling Dagger first; with a hard lane and an early move to the jungle, Phantom Strike first (the lane-pressure tip names it, skill_tips). Talents 10: Phantom Strike Duration 342/499 (49.7%), Stifling Dagger Cooldown 157/499 (39.5%); 15: Immaterial Evasion 276/460 (50.0%), Stifling Dagger Damage 184/460 (48.9%); 20: Phantom Strike Attack Speed 170/292 (64.7%), Phantom Strike Cast Range 122/292 (54.1%); 25: Triple Strike Stifling Dagger 64/95 (70.3%), Coup de Grace chance 31/95 (67.7%).
